Teja Kumar has gone outside to hire a mini bus to take their family to Tirupati Balaji Temple but he is stopped by a lion in his way. Teja is feeling very helpless and praying for his life. However, on the other side Shanti, Laxmi and Bhanu is pretending before Amma, as if they are in a train but in reality they are in a waiting room of a railway station! Want to know more? Then stay tuned in and find out here!
